question: What is the tenure of the Chairman and members of the Union Public Service Commission?

options.text: 5 years or till the age of 62 years
6 years or till the age of 65 years
6 years or till the age of 62 years

solution:
The correct answer is __**6 years or till the age of 65 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The tenure of the **Chairman** and members of the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** is governed by constitutional provisions and is clearly specified in the rules.
 
• As per **Article 316** of the **Constitution of India**, the tenure of the Chairman and members of the UPSC is **6 years or until they attain the age of 65 years**, whichever is earlier. Hence, the correct answer is 6 years or till the age of 65 years.
 
• This ensures that individuals holding these positions cannot continue indefinitely, maintaining fairness and transparency in the functioning of the UPSC.
